name: Starlight Anemone Observatory
introDiscord: A living observatory rises from the reef, its great anemones turning toward the night sky like telescopes. Constellations ripple across their glowing fronds while several smaller blooms appear to be arguing about a star.
introTwitch: A living observatory rises from the reef, its great anemones turning toward the night sky like telescopes. Constellations ripple across their glowing fronds while several smaller blooms appear to be arguing about a star.

astral-lens.prompt: A living lens opens overhead, bending starlight into three paths. Several Anemones swivel toward you at once. You have apparently interrupted observation hours.

left.message: One Starlight Anemone points a glowing frond toward a constellation. You fail to react appropriately. It points again. You still don't understand. The Anemone has apparently chosen violence as its third teaching method.

right.message: Shizuki's infusion waits beneath the lens: "Made under observation by several judgmental anemones. They gave the brewing technique two stars. Out of what, they refused to say."
right.fullHpMessage: The Anemones' two-star infusion remains unused. You are already at full health, though they still seem disappointed.

forward.message: A moon-shell coffer sits directly beneath a focused beam of starlight. When the constellation above aligns, the lid opens and exposes Star Candies.

starstem-gallery.prompt: Tall starstem columns project constellations across the gallery floor. Anemones turn the projections whenever you approach, as though correcting your route.

left.message: A Fae vessel rests beneath a constellation shaped suspiciously like a Berry. You decide this is obviously a sign and collect Star Candies instead.

right.message: A Starlight Anemone has arranged its fronds into a perfect astronomical display. You accidentally step on the projected moon. The Anemone reacts like you just vandalized a masterpiece.

forward.message: One Berry is tied to Shizuki's star chart exactly where her 'astronomy lesson' becomes an escape route. Beside it she wrote: "That star means north. Probably. Teacher disagreed."

nightbloom-deck.prompt: The highest deck faces the dark water above. Nightblooms unfold beneath the stars while three corridors descend through a moving field of projected constellations.

left.message: Shizuki's restorative reads: "For anyone climbing higher than common sense recommends. Observatory rating: too high. View rating: worth it."
left.fullHpMessage: Shizuki's high-altitude restorative remains sealed. At full health, you can enjoy the view without inviting another Observatory rating.

right.message: A Moonkeeper cache opens only when three anemones point at it simultaneously. After several minutes of waiting for them to agree, you recover Star Candies.

forward.message: One enormous bloom swivels away from the sky and toward you. A smaller Starlight Anemone follows its gaze and decides you are tonight's astronomical event.

boss-antechamber.name: Zenith Orrery
boss-antechamber.prompt: The observatory culminates beneath a living orrery of enormous petals. Every constellation converges on one closed bloom suspended at its center.

bossPromptDiscord:
The stars projected across the chamber suddenly vanish.

Every Anemone bends toward the central flower.

One brilliant point of light appears inside it.

Then the petals begin opening.

Use /yes to approach or /no to leave tonight's observation unfinished.
bossPromptTwitch:
The stars projected across the chamber suddenly vanish.

Every Anemone bends toward the central flower.

One brilliant point of light appears inside it.

Then the petals begin opening.

Use !yes to approach or !no to leave tonight's observation unfinished.
bossRetreatText: You leave the Zenith Orrery unfinished. The central petals close around their point of light, and the Anemones return to judging the stars.

boss.revealText: The central bloom opens like a living star, enormous luminous fronds sweeping across the orrery. The Zenith Bloom has awakened!

completionText: The Zenith Bloom folds its fronds and returns to tracking the heavens. The smaller anemones resume their observations. One points at you, then at a newly opened route. You're fairly sure that means 'go.'
